\begin{document}
For the product of two contour functions taken at the same pair of contour times,
$C(\tau,\tau') = A(\tau,\tau')B(\tau,\tau')$, which we abbreviate as $C = AB$,
the Langreth rules give
\begin{equation}
C^{<} = A^{<} B^{<} .
\label{eq:pl}
\end{equation}
and for the retarded component
\begin{equation}
C^{r} = A^{r} B^{<} + A^{<} B^{r} + A^{r} B^{r} .
\label{eq:pr}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
